subject: Request: CTO intervention for one-time sandbox top-up & extended evaluation
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@veritastx.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Short extension + sandbox top-up request — integration delay

Marcus —

Appreciate the productive demo last week. We started integration testing this morning and hit a blocker with the data mapping layer that will take our eng team ~3 extra weeks to resolve. That pushes our evaluation timeline past the standard 30‑day sandbox window.

Given the traction here and our internal timelines (regulatory window in Q2), can Redwood make a one-time exception: add 100k free token credits and extend the sandbox by 45 days? We need the additional tokens to fully exercise our import and generation flows.

If it helps, I can share the updated MAP and test logs. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of AI Platforms
Veritas Therapeutics

Attachment: integration_log_snippet.txt (text stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:48:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Short extension + sandbox top-up request — integration delay

Looping you both in — Elena from Veritas (prospect) is asking for a one-off 100k free token top-up + 45 day extension. They were in our demo cohort last month and have serious compliance requirements (biopharma).

Context: they are enterprise-middle market, evaluating for a regulated use-case; committed to a pilot integration but need runway to finish data mapping. HubSpot deal attached: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890.

Ask: can we authorize this one-off outside PLG defaults? If yes, what signoff do we need (CTO/CRO/CEO)? Also need suggested guardrails — e.g., limited to sandbox, no production access, one-time only, and agree to a mutual action plan.

I attached a short cost estimate and a draft MAP I pulled together. If legal needs to touch terms, please flag.

—Marcus
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Topup_Summary.xlsx, MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short extension + sandbox top-up request — integration delay

Thanks Marcus — reviewed. My recommendation: approve the sandbox-only top-up under a short written addendum with the following conditions:

- One-time grant: 100,000 free tokens, no roll-over.
- Duration: additional 45 calendar days starting from today.
- Environment: sandbox only; no production keys or dedicated capacity.
- Security/evidence: Veritas must complete the SOC questionnaire and share the updated MAP within 72 hours.
- Business trigger: if they sign an MSA or a 6‑month paid commitment within the 45‑day window, we credit 30% of granted tokens toward first invoice (non-refundable otherwise).
- Legal/finance: minimal addendum + sign-off on HubSpot deal by BD and legal.

Estimated cost to Redwood (opportunity cost + infra): ~$2,400 (GPU tokens) — see Topup_Summary.xlsx.

If we need executive signoff, this should be fine for Laura to approve as Head of Sales. CTO asks (if raised) would be limited to ensuring sandbox isolation which is baked into our Dedicated/Sandbox policy.

I attached a draft addendum and a one-pager. If you want, I can send Elena the formal addendum for signature via DocuSign.

—Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf, Topup_Summary.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short extension + sandbox top-up request — integration delay

Approved. Laura here — I reviewed Jordan's plan and cost estimate. Provide Elena the one-time grant under these strict conditions:

1) 100,000 free tokens, sandbox-only, 45 day extension from 2026-01-16.
2) MAP and completed SOC questionnaire received and attached to the HubSpot deal within 72 hours. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890.
3) No production keys or admin access; engineering will validate isolation. Ops to tag the grant with deal RW-VER-2026-007 for tracking.
4) If they convert to a paid commitment within 45 days, automatically apply a 30% token credit to their first invoice; otherwise no refunds.
5) Legal to execute a short addendum; send via DocuSign (https://docusign.net/verify/ABC123XYZ).

Jordan — please send the addendum to Elena and attach the MAP. Marcus — confirm once Gov/InfoSec gets the SOC artifacts. I'll update the deal stage and log the exec approval in the deal notes.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
